caption: The drawing depicts a quilt composed of 36 diamond-shaped blocks arranged in a square grid, bordered by a solid dark green strip. Each block features a unique geometric, floral, or symbolic motif rendered in shades of red, green, yellow, and orange on a cream-white background. The designs include symmetrical stars, stylized flowers, leafy branches, potted plants, medallions, and abstract forms, each outlined and filled with the vivid colors mentioned. The quilt is further accented by smaller diamond shapes set on the outer edge, and the inner blocks are all separated by a green border, creating a grid effect. The arrangement and repetition of certain colors and motifs contribute to the overall visual harmony of the composition.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
